replication.description:
Grant replication privileges.

Allows the user to:
- Connect in replication mode
- Use streaming replication functions
- Receive WAL for physical or logical replication

Required for backup tools and read replicas.

role.description:
Role for this database.

Possible values:
- 'admin': full access (read/write/create/drop tables, sequences, functions)
- 'readonly': read-only access (SELECT on tables, USAGE on sequences/functions)
- '' (empty): no role on this database

config.description: User configuration: privileges and per-database role assignments
